changelog:
0.9.7

  • The good-bots bar is one block again. Splitting it into four separate
boxes made a small "Google 33" look as important as a large total and it no longer read as a single group. The block now keeps its name and its total and changes colour inside: dark blue for Google, light blue for Bing, then the rest. A small key under the bar says which blue is which.
